description: Saves the cards the user used to have and no longer holds, with the months they know (opened, closed, when the welcome bonus posted). compare_welcome_offers then checks each issuer's published repeat-bonus rule against them and the saved cards: "Chase says you may not get this bonus again", or "Not before March 2027". Only the card id is needed; ask for months only when the issuer's rule counts from one. Replaces the whole list, so call list_wallet first and include the ones to keep. Only rules issuers publish are checked; never assume one (5/24 is skippedIssuers on set_memberships). Never suggest closing a card to earn a bonus again. It uses the wallet file on this computer, not the hosted earnrate connector's wallet.

pastCards.description: Cards the user used to have and no longer holds, with the months they know. Only the card is needed; months make the dates exact. Replaces the saved list, so include the ones to keep; [] clears it.

bonusMet.description: YYYY-MM a tracked bonus's spending was reached, as list_wallet gives it (bonusMet). Pass it back unchanged; never ask for it.

bonusReceived.description: YYYY-MM its welcome bonus posted, or "none" if it never paid one.

cardId.description: The card id from search_cards, e.g. chase-sapphire-preferred.
